verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a SaaS compliance and case-management platform, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis. The evidence documents only inbound APIs (Alerts, Case, Case import), polling-style retrieval (listing cases, monitoring filing status), and in-app or email notifications. Nothing documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
